problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained zero-finding for a possibly nonmonotone L-Lipschitz operator F: ℝ^d → ℝ^d satisfying a weak Minty inequality. No objective function or saddle representation is required.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact full operator evaluation F(x) at any queried x. Replies have no error or dependence on history or oracle randomness. All parameters d, L, ρ, x0, R, ε are public; F and the witnessing solution are hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/EuclideanWeakMinty.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.Query, spec.Reply, and first conjunct of spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean geometry on ℝ^d with d ≥ 257.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Globally L-Lipschitz F with L > 0. There exists xstar with F(xstar)=0, ‖xstar−x0‖≤R, and ⟨F(x),x−xstar⟩≥−ρ‖F(x)‖² for every x. Parameters satisfy 0≤ρ≤1/(20L), ε>0, and 28ε≤LR.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/EuclideanWeakMinty.lean: spec.valid and second and third conjuncts of spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The guarantee averages over algorithm and oracle seeds; exact oracle replies do not require the algorithm to be deterministic.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/EuclideanWeakMinty.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and Algorithm.law.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Return a point xhat whose operator residual norm is integrable and satisfies E‖F(xhat)‖≤ε; the norm is not squared. No last-iterate requirement is imposed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The weak Minty inequality permits nonmonotone operators through a residual-dependent negative inner-product bound, giving a structured variant of classical monotone variational inequalities.

descriptionHtml:
Euclidean Weak Minty Root Finding

We consider finding a zero of an L-Lipschitz map F:Rd→Rd, where d≥257 and L>0. A given point x0 lies within Euclidean distance R>0 of a zero x⋆ satisfying the weak Minty condition ⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩≥−ρ∥F(x)∥2 for every x, with 0≤ρ≤1/(20L). The oracle returns F(x) at x. For ε>0 with 28ε≤LR, the goal is an output x¯ with integrable residual norm and EP∥F(x¯)∥≤ε, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The root-finding problem is to find x∈Rd such that F(x)=0. Throughout, ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ and ∥⋅∥ denote the standard Euclidean inner product and norm. The algorithm receives d,L,ρ,x0,R, and ε, with parameter ranges d∈N,d≥257,L>0,0≤ρ≤120L,R>0,ε>0,28ε≤LR.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Lipschitz continuity). For every x,y∈Rd, ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Weak Minty condition and initial distance). There exists x⋆∈Rd such that F(x⋆)=0,∥x⋆−x0∥≤R,⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩≥−ρ∥F(x)∥2for every x∈Rd.

Queries may be made at any point of Rd. After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯∈Rd must have integrable residual norm under P and satisfy EP[∥F(x¯)∥]≤ε.

theorems.referencesHtml: • Jelena Diakonikolas, Constantinos Daskalakis, Michael I. Jordan. Efficient Methods for Structured Nonconvex-Nonconcave Min-Max Optimization. 2021 (preprint 2020). comparisonHtml:
F:Rd→Rd is L-Lipschitz, with F(x⋆)=0, ∥x⋆−x0∥≤R, and ⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩≥−ρ∥F(x)∥2 for every x. Parameters satisfy L,ε>0, 0≤ρL≤1/20, 28ε≤LR, and d≥257. Each query returns exact F(x); the setup imposes no algorithm restriction. The target is an integrable residual with ∫∥F(x^(ω))∥dP(ω)≤ε, where P is the execution probability law.

Exact-operator residual complexity for EuclideanWeakMinty.
Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations
(1) EuclideanWeakMintyLowerBound (Ours) (⋆⋆⋆) (review) Ω(min{L2R2/ε2,d1/3}) necessary calls, for arbitrary randomized algorithms and outputs; hard instances already satisfy ρ=0.
(2) EuclideanWeakMintyExtragradient (Ours) (review) O(L2R2/ε2) sufficient calls. Matches (1) up to universal factors if d≥257(LR/(28ε))6; otherwise a dimension-dependent gap remains.
(3) (Yoon and Ryu 2021), Theorem 3 Ω(LR/ε) necessary calls. Monotone biaffine saddle operators; deterministic separate-span methods. For N queries: d=2n, n≥N+2. (1): (LR/ε)2 instead of LR/ε when d≥257(LR/(28ε))6; stronger order whenever d1/3≫LR/ε. Scope: arbitrary randomized methods/outputs; nonmonotone Minty hard instances. (1) needs d≫(LR/ε)3 for an order improvement; (3) needs dimension only linear in its necessary budget.
(4) EG+ (Diakonikolas et al. 2021), Theorem 3.2 O(1+L2R2(1−8ρL)ε2) exact F calls; 0≤ρL<1/8. (2): matches known rate on the shared parameter range; formalization of the EG+ guarantee. (2) has a worse leading constant; requires ρL≤1/20, d≥257, and 28ε≤LR.
(5) CEG+ (Pethick et al. 2023), Corollary 3.2 O(L2R2/ε2) exact F calls on the shared setup, with the unconstrained resolvent equal to the identity. (2): matches known rate on the shared setup. (2) covers only ρL≤1/20; (5) permits ρL<1/2 and constrained inclusions.
(6) (Pethick et al. 2025), Theorem 6.1(i), Corollary 6.3 O(L2R2/ε2) exact F calls on the shared setup, including inner evaluations; the unconstrained resolvent is the identity. (2): matches known rate on the shared setup. (2) covers only ρL≤1/20; (6) permits ρL<1 and constrained inclusions; displayed cost is restricted to the shared range.

Abbr: L: operator Lipschitz constant; R: initial root-distance bound; ρ: weak-Minty parameter; ε: residual tolerance; d: dimension; N: exact operator-query count. Ω denotes necessary complexity, O sufficient complexity. All ρ ranges use the setup’s sign and normalization; the squared-residual tolerances in the cited upper bounds are set to ε2.

import LongTails.Template
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Basic

namespace LongTails.Setups.EuclideanWeakMinty

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

structure Params where
  d : ℕ
  L : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  x0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Query p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Reply p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Output p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 < p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.ρ ∧ p.ρ ≤ 1 / (20 * p.L) ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧
    28 * p.ε ≤ p.L * p.R ∧ 257 ≤ p.d
  admissible p F oracle :=
    (∀ k seed x, oracle.answer k (0, x) seed = F x) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ p.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, F xstar = 0 ∧ ‖xstar - p.x0‖ ≤ p.R ∧
      ∀ x, -p.ρ * ‖F x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪F x, x - xstar⟫)
  successful p F output P :=
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖F (output ω)‖) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, ‖F (output ω)‖ ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.EuclideanWeakMinty
